# 🔧 KServerInfo – Advanced Server Monitoring Plugin

KServerInfo is a powerful Minecraft plugin that provides real-time server statistics in a clean, customizable format. It's perfect for administrators who need quick insights into server health with minimal performance impact.
⭐ Key Features:

    ✅ Real-time CPU monitoring (system & process level)

    ✅ Memory usage tracking (used / allocated / max)

    ✅ Disk space analysis

    ✅ Uptime display (days / hours / minutes)

    ✅ Multi-language support: English & Hungarian

    ✅ Multiple command aliases: /ksi, /ksinfo, /serverinfo

    ✅ Permission-based access control

    ✅ Debug mode for detailed diagnostics

# 📦 Commands:

    /ksi – View server info

    /ksi reload – Reload the configuration

    /ksi lang [en|hu] – Change language

    /ksi debug – Toggle debug mode

# 🔄 Fully compatible with all modern Minecraft versions.

 🇭🇺 🇬🇧 support!
